text:
These are and shall be the last tears that, with a living voice's force, I lose in this fugitive fountain carrying them to so many beasts' thirst.


Happy am I if on foreign shores, feeding such elusive grief, I find merciful death, which topples this vain architecture of chimeras!


A naked spirit, pure lover, I shall burn above the sun, and the cold body will remember Love in dust and earth.


I shall be my own epitaph to the traveler, for my lifeless face will say: “It once was Love's glory to wage war on me.”

translation.title: These Are and Shall Be the Last...
